# PDFCursor

> Lightweight WASM-Powered Client-Side PDF Generation Library for JavaScript & TypeScript.

PDFCursor is an ultra-lightweight, zero-dependency, client-side PDF generation engine compiled from C++ to WebAssembly (emsdk). It generates PDF 1.7 compliant binary streams directly in the browser with real-dimension point coordinates, standard Base14 fonts, CJK CID fonts, vector graphics, 1D/2D barcodes, digital signatures, image embedding, and gradient shading.

## Main Documentation

- [README.md](README.md): Project overview, core features, quick start, and license terms.
- [API Reference](API.md): Complete technical specification of `PDFCursor` class methods, parameters, and TypeScript interfaces.
- [Practical Guide & Recipes](GUIDE.md): Production-ready code examples for data tables, barcodes, watermarks, digital signatures, headers/footers, and text measurement.
- [Limitations & Caveats](LIMITATIONS.md): Constraints on font embedding, PDF 1.7 compliance, graphics state rules, and browser PDF viewers.

## Quick Start Example (JavaScript ES Modules)

```html
<script type="module">
import Module from './pdfCursor.mjs';

async function generatePDF() {
  const mod = await Module();
  const pdc = new mod.PDFCursor();

  pdc.beginPage("A4 landscape", { title: "Sample Document" })
     .font("Helvetica", 16)
     .textAt(100, 100, "Hello, World!")
     .endPage();

  const pdfBlob = pdc.getBlob();
  const pdfUrl = URL.createObjectURL(pdfBlob);
  document.getElementById("viewer").data = pdfUrl;
}

generatePDF();
</script>
```

## TypeScript Usage

```typescript
import Module from './pdfCursor.mjs';
import type { PDFCursor, PaperFormat, StandardFont } from './pdfCursor';

async function generatePDF(): Promise<void> {
  const mod = await Module();
  const pdc: PDFCursor = new mod.PDFCursor();

  pdc.beginPage('A4', { title: 'TypeScript Sample' })
     .font('Gothic-JP-H', 12)
     .textAt(50, 750, 'PDFCursor Document')
     .endPage();

  const pdfBlob: Blob = pdc.getBlob();
}
```

## Key Technical Specifications

- **Coordinate System**: Origin at bottom-left corner (0, 0), unit in points (1 pt = 1/72 inch ≈ 0.3528 mm), precision up to 0.01 pt.
- **Supported Fonts**: Standard PDF Base14 fonts (Helvetica, Times-Roman, Courier, Symbol, ZapfDingbats) and CJK CID fonts (Mincho & Gothic for JP, TW, KR, CN). Custom TTF/OTF embedding is omitted by design to maintain minimal WASM binary footprint.
- **Barcodes**: Native vector generators for 1D (Code128, EAN13, JAN8, ITF) and 2D (QR, QRH, DataMatrix) barcodes.
- **Graphics & Utilities**: Path geometry, clipping (`beginClip`/`endClip`), gradient shading (`shadeRef`/`shadeAt`), PNG/JPEG images with soft-mask alpha transparency, SHA-256 digest (`digest()`), and PKCS#7 digital signature embedding (`digiSign()`).
- **Read-Only State Properties**: `$W` (page width), `$H` (page height), `$x`, `$y` (last coordinates), `$f` (last font size), `$a` (last anchor), `$s` (last text string).
